scenes.headline: How a computer fits inside a language model
scenes.sub: A RISC-V core compiled into Qwen3.5-4B
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Opcode! This model has a small computer compiled into its weights.

scenes.text: Qwen3.5's linear-attention layers keep a state matrix. With a one-hot key and full write strength, one row of it works as exact RAM.
scenes.say: Qwen's linear attention keeps a state matrix. Pin the gate and the write strength, point with a one-hot key, and a row becomes exact memory.

scenes.title: The delta rule
scenes.text: S = S + beta k (v - k^T S)

parts.say: Beta says how far the row moves toward the new value. At one, it is replaced completely.

parts.note: which row, as a one-hot key
parts.say: A one-hot key points at exactly one row, like an address.
The update is the new value minus what that row held, so the old value cancels.

scenes.say: The update is one line of linear algebra.

steps.say: The first eleven layers are the compiled CPU. They have the shape of Qwen layers and are almost all zeros.
Then come Qwen's own thirty-two layers, bit-identical in every row I compared, padded from 2,560 to 3,968 dimensions.

scenes.title: One instruction
scenes.say: Each instruction is a few generated tokens.

items.say: The circuit reads its operand registers with one-hot queries.
Feed-forward units do the arithmetic with thresholds that are exact in bf16.
A write token with beta one replaces the destination row.

scenes.label: instructions of a toy machine, none lost
scenes.note: 12,345 x 6,789 by repeated addition, memory in delta-rule rows
scenes.say: My toy machine ran twenty thousand three hundred seventy-one instructions through the real recurrence and matched plain Python.

scenes.text: The memory is exact only when the keys are one-hot and large enough that the norm's epsilon vanishes.
scenes.say: So the memory is exact only with one-hot keys that are large enough for the normalisation epsilon to vanish.

recap: A row of state is RAM.
scenes.say: A row of state is RAM, eleven layers are the CPU, and Qwen's weights stay as they were.
